description: Writes a sheet-metal part's flat pattern as DXF or DWG, the file a cutting machine takes, in the part's units. The part must be saved to disk: a part never saved is refused before SOLIDWORKS is called (save it with sw_document_save_as first), because SOLIDWORKS then opens a Save As box that waits for the user. A part with unsaved changes is exported as it is now. The part need not be flattened: it keeps its state (folded or flattened) and its path, and the part that was active is made active again. It keeps its unsaved-changes flag too, except that ExportToDWG2 marks a saved part as changed on SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP4: then marked_dirty is true, and the part is not saved behind you. Bend lines are drawn unless bend_lines is false; the part's visible sketches only when sketches is true. Checked on disk: the file was written by this call and is not empty; a DXF parses, the extents of its entities match the flat size from the cut list (sw_sheetmetal_read's flat) within 0.01 mm beyond the cut list's own rounding, turned or not (the header's extents are reported, not compared), and it holds a bend line for each bend when bend lines were asked for, and none when they were not (with sketches drawn that is reported, not checked: a sketch's lines look the same); a DWG starts with its AC10xx version and is at least 1 KB (its extents are not read). Otherwise verification_failed, naming the check; the file is left where it was written. A SOLIDWORKS call that writes nothing is followed by the next (with bend lines or sketches, ExportToDWG2 first, since ExportFlatPatternView draws no bend lines; without, ExportFlatPatternView, then ExportToDWG2), and operation_failed lists every attempt when none writes.

document.description: The sheet-metal part: its title or full path. The active document when absent.

path.description: Full path of the file to write, in an existing folder, ending .dxf or .dwg as format says.

bend_lines.description: Draw the bend lines. Default true.

sketches.description: Draw the part's visible sketches too. Default false.

overwrite.description: Replace the file if it exists. Default false.
